project.title: Single-stage Partial Nitritation/Anammox SBR System: Nitrogen Conversion pathways, Numerical Micro-ecology and in suit Microbial Community
project.description: Autotrophic nitrogen removal technique based on anaerobic ammonium oxidation (anammox) is the most economical and low carbon emission process currently, a study on the active microbial community diversity was conducted in a partial nitritation anammox reactor by using 15N-DNA-SIP technique.
